source.name: Wanted Design System Community component screenshots
source.purpose: Record user-provided Figma section screenshots that expose component taxonomy, variants, states, and resource examples before full node-level Figma reads are available.

extractedStructure: Section groups visible in the source screenshot: Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, Framed Style.

Textinput includes Textfield and Textarea examples with development platform tags, status rows, size/height rows, active/focus/disabled states, helper/required/description treatment, icon/button slots, autocomplete behavior, preview compositions, and resource examples.

Select includes render modes for text and chip, active/open state, focus, normal/negative status, disabled state, heading, required and description rows, overflow examples, leading icon treatment, preview compositions, and resource examples.

Control includes Checkbox, Radio, Check Mark, and Switch. Checkbox/Radio/Check Mark show size, checked/unchecked states, tight layout, label on/off, disabled, customization by typography and typography color, interaction states, and resource examples.
Checkbox specifically shows unchecked, checked, and indeterminate states.
Switch shows platform variants normal and iOS, size small/medium, active on/off, disabled on/off, vertical resource examples, and normal/iOS visual treatments.
Segmented Control shows solid and outlined variants, small/medium/large sizes, icon on/off variants, inactive/active/focus/active-focus compositions, and a resource example.

Framed Style shows selected on/off, disabled, normal/negative status, normal/hovered/focused interaction states, radius/padding customization, shadow scale customization, selected/error/disabled frame compositions, and resource examples.
screenshots.coverageImpact: Adds screenshot-level evidence for WDS Selection and Input child taxonomy and state matrices. The visible PNG states are represented through existing LDS components, including Checkbox variant="mark" and ChoiceCard presentation="frame"; exact Figma child nodes, component properties, and variant names still require direct Figma metadata/design-context reads.
